newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance on Monday said that it qualified eight municipal bond issues, which will be sold competitively, for insurance.
--New Haven Unified School District, Calif., $14 million General Obligations.
--Elk River Independent School District #728, Minn., $26.950 million GOs.
--Eveleth-Gilbert Independent School District, Minn., $3.6 million GOs.
--Woodcliff Lake Board of Education, N.J., $4.358 million GOs.
--Highland Village, Texas, $4.090 million Tax and Revenues.
